tex_content.html: \begin{equation} {d\log {\mathcal J}(v,\tau )\over d\tau }\bigg|_{\bar\tau } \le {n\over 2\bar\tau }-\tfrac 12\bar\tau ^{-3/2}K. \end{equation} Thus the integrand and $\chi _\tau $ are nonincreasing, so $\tilde V$ is nonincreasing. If equality holds, then \begin{equation} 2\Ric (\tau )+\tau ^{-1/2}\Hess _{L(\tau )}=\tau ^{-1}g(\tau ),\end{equation} and the flow is a gradient shrinking soliton.
